name: prereg
description: /prereg <slug> <plan> has Claude write prereg/<slug>.json (hypothesis, gates, thresholds, SHA256) before any result is seen. A guard then refuses edits to a pre-registration once results exist: prereg/<slug>.result.json or results/<slug>*, and the legacy PREREGISTRATION_<tag>.md once PREREG_<tag>_RESULT.sha256 exists.
